name: MnRI Technology Day Camp (grades 6 to 8)
org: Minnesota Robotics Institute, University of Minnesota
what_you_do: Spend 3 days learning about robots. Build a robot, solder, design circuits, draw parts on a computer and program robots. On the last day you give a short talk about what you made.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 6 to 8. Only 30 kids can attend. Students who came before are asked not to sign up again, since the activities stay the same.
duration: 3 days, 9 a.m. to 3:45 p.m. (drop off from 8:15 a.m., pick up by 4 p.m.)
deadline_text: Summer 2026 camp was August 3 to 5, 2026. Sign up is closed. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the camp page for the next sign up.
notes: Drop off and pick up are at Keller Hall on the Minneapolis campus. One parent or guardian may come to the talks on Wednesday afternoon. Not a job.
